verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API, OpenAPI spec, webhooks, PATs, OAuth connections, and an official MCP server show broad programmatic access to pages, databases, comments, and users, but Notion's own docs qualify this as reading/creating/updating 'nearly everything' — not full UI parity (e.g., no evidence of API control over workspace settings, views, permissions, or account-level administration). Missing for 10: explicit coverage of all UI-only features (views, permissions, workspace admin), independent confirmation that API users never hit UI-only limitations.
